    @hk.transparent
    def _apply_rope(self, *heads: jax.Array, positions: jax.Array | None) -> tuple[jax.Array, ...]:
        t: jax.Array | None = None
        if positions is not None:
            t = positions[..., 0].astype(jnp.float32)

        match self.config.rope_type:
            case "1d":
                rotate = RotaryEmbedding(
                    dim=self.config.key_size,
                    base_exponent=self.config.rope_base_exponent,
                )
                return tuple(rotate(x, 1, 0, t) for x in heads)
            case _:
                raise NotImplementedError(f"Rope type {self.config.rope_type} is not supported")

def prefix_hidden(self, emb_sorted: jax.Array, slate_sorted: jax.Array) -> jax.Array:
        d = emb_sorted.shape[-1]
        w_h, _ = self._hidden(d)
        slate_f = slate_sorted.astype(jnp.float32)[:, :, None]
        emb_f = emb_sorted.astype(jnp.float32)

        pl = jnp.einsum("bsd,dh->bsh", emb_f, w_h[2 * d + 1 :]) * slate_f
        count = jnp.cumsum(slate_f, axis=1) - slate_f

        last_h = jnp.concatenate([jnp.zeros_like(pl[:, :1]), pl[:, :-1]], axis=1)
        return mean_h + last_h
